entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return something. Order number is 772-B-4915. Just tell me if I can or not.

Certainly. Let me pull up that order for you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit Spin Class Shoes. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
They don't work for me. The cycling shoes gave me terrible blisters after just one class, and the placement for the cleats feels off. I just want a refund.
I'm very sorry to hear they're causing blisters. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you.
Look, it's a simple yes or no. Can I return them or not?
Yes, you can. I've just confirmed it. You received them 42 days ago, and our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. You're well within that window for a full refund.
Okay, good. What's the next step?

I've just processed the return authorization and emailed a prepaid shipping label to you. I also noticed you're a VIP member with us. For the inconvenience, I've added a $20 credit to your account for any future purchase.
A label and a credit. Great. That works. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
